name: Bocchi Furaiki: NEET no Nihon Isshuu Baiku Tabi
original_name: ぼっち風来記：ニートの日本一周バイク旅
source:
A Visual Novel of Quiet Summer Memories

This is a quiet memory of a journey—no success, no encounters, no grand moments.

Summer 2007. For two months, a socially awkward man rode alone from Kyushu toward Hokkaido, crossing Japan on two wheels. Engine sounds, evening seas, solitary nights under stars. Sometimes pushing through wind and rain, covered in mud on rough mountain roads. An authentic 26-year-old NEET's journey, told through real photographs from the time.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4035500/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
静谧夏日回忆的视觉小说

这是一段安静的旅程记忆——没有成功，没有遭遇，没有伟大的时刻。

2007年夏天。两个月来，一名不善社交的男子独自骑两轮车从九州前往北海道，穿越日本。发动机的声音、傍晚的大海、星空下孤独的夜晚。有时顶着风雨，在崎岖的山路上满身是泥。通过真实的照片讲述一个真实的26岁尼特族的旅程。
